name: bandit.extortion_committed_contact_movement_seed_route_confirm_mcw
description: Superseding R-009 seed route: ordinary overmap pan plus the game's documented two-step efficient-route confirmation reaches the M061 basecamp-adjacent footing before native Save-and-Quit. No fixture data is transformed.

steps.label: post_load_preopportunity_hud
steps.abort_reason: the production-created bootstrap save did not reach the gameplay HUD

steps.label: open_overmap_for_ordinary_basecamp_travel
steps.expected_visible_fact: the standard overmap is open before selecting the known basecamp-adjacent destination

steps.label: pan_to_known_basecamp_adjacency_destination
steps.expected_visible_fact: ordinary overmap cursor movement selects M061's absolute OMT (164,35,0)

steps.label: preview_ordinary_route_to_basecamp_adjacency
steps.expected_visible_fact: the game's documented efficient-route preview is shown before ordinary travel begins

steps.label: confirm_ordinary_route_to_basecamp_adjacency
steps.expected_visible_fact: the game's second documented route command confirms ordinary travel to M061's basecamp-adjacent footing

steps.label: audit_player_save_before_seed_save
steps.abort_reason: the copied production-created save was absent before its ordinary save

steps.label: open_seed_full_save_prompt
steps.abort_reason: the normal Save-and-Quit confirmation was not visibly open

steps.label: audit_player_save_after_seed_save
steps.abort_reason: the native Save-and-Quit action did not update the copied player save

steps.label: audit_saved_basecamp_adjacency_footing
steps.abort_reason: the saved player location was not the ordinary M061 basecamp-adjacent footing
steps.expected_immediate_state: the current-executable native save records player absolute OMT (164,35,0), the source-side basecamp-adjacent footing for opportunity observation

evidence_contract.claim: the current executable moves the avatar through the game-documented overmap route UI to the named basecamp-adjacent footing and saves it through native Save-and-Quit
evidence_contract.preconditions_and_interventions: the harness copies a production-created save with save_transforms=[] and sends only normal overmap movement/route/save keys
evidence_contract.terminal: this is seed evidence only; it creates no hostile state and claims no shakedown outcome
